description: The structural twin of composition. Where SQL injection turns on whether the caller's data was built INTO text, this turns on whether it was built into an object: `Object.assign(user, req.body)` hands over every key the caller sent, and `Object.assign(user, {displayName: req.body.displayName})` hands over one the application named. The values in the second route are exactly as untrusted as in the first, and that is not the weakness -- the weakness is the caller choosing which fields get written. The clone route is the negative that was found in production before it could become a false positive: the target is a fresh object literal, so there is no record being written and no field anybody could reach.

expected.note: the caller's whole object is copied onto a record, so any field of it is writable
